Also, I'm curious about the distance between these two locations. Furthermore, I'm planning a weekend getaway to Los Angeles, so I'd like to know the traffic estimate from Palo Alto to Los Angeles for the coming weekend. Lastly, could you provide me with a 5-day weather forecast for Los Angeles?"

function.description: Calculate distance between two locations. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

function.name: weather_forecast
function.description: Retrieve a weather forecast for a specific location and time frame. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

location.description: The city that you want to get the weather for.

days.description: Number of days for the forecast.

function.name: traffic_estimate
function.description: Estimate traffic from one location to another for a specific time period. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

time_period.description: Specify a time frame to estimate the traffic, 'now' for current, 'weekend' for the coming weekend. Default is 'now'.
